4472 rhantizo {hran-tid'-zo}

衍生於 rhaino (灑); TDNT - 6:976,984; 動詞

AV - sprinkle 4; 4

1) 灑佈
2) 潔淨
 2a) 禮儀上的 (#可 7:4|)
 2b) 讓自己純淨 (#來 10:22| )
record.edic_text:
4472 rhantizo {hran-tid'-zo}

from a derivative of rhaino (to sprinkle); TDNT - 6:976,984; v

AV - sprinkle 4; 4

1) to sprinkle
2) to cleanse by sprinkling, hence to purify, cleanse

same.cexp: 灑；＜關＞洗滌（自己）；＜被＞被洗或潔淨
